description: This PHP source file defines the class OAuthPluginBase, which extends ExternalAPIBase and implements ExternalOAuthAPIPlugin. It provides OAuth-related functionality for external API integrations within the SuiteCRM system, including setting up OAuth parameters, handling OAuth login flows, and managing OAuth tokens associated with an EAPM bean.

classes.name: OAuthPluginBase
classes.description: Class providing OAuth authentication management for external API integrations, including token setup, login flow control, and token storage linked to EAPM beans.

methods.name: setupOauthKeys
methods.description: Initializes OAuth consumer key and secret parameters from the connector object.

methods.name: loadEAPM
methods.description: Loads OAuth tokens from the given EAPM bean and calls the parent method.

methods.name: checkLogin
methods.description: Verifies login status by calling parent method and then confirming OAuth login if necessary.

methods.name: quickCheckLogin
methods.description: Performs a quick login check based on existing OAuth tokens.

methods.name: checkOauthLogin
methods.description: Checks if OAuth tokens are present; initiates OAuth login flow if not.

methods.name: getOauth
methods.description: Creates and returns a configured SugarOAuth object, setting tokens if available.

methods.name: oauthLogin
methods.description: Manages the OAuth login flow, obtaining request tokens, redirecting for authorization, and exchanging tokens for access tokens, with token persistence in the EAPM bean.
